content_corrections.issue: Four marks were assigned to an under-specified phrase-only singular transformation.
content_corrections.resolution: Reframed as a full sentence rewrite and aligned the four memo points to quantity, noun number, adjective retention, and sentence punctuation.

content_corrections.issue: Four marks were assigned to an equal-grouping item that did not request working or a remainder.
content_corrections.resolution: Asked for the method and leftover tops; the memo grants carry-forward credit and distinguishes quotient, remainder and reported result.

content_corrections.issue: Seven marks were assigned to a single subtraction result without requiring visible working or verification.
content_corrections.resolution: Asked for column subtraction, visible regrouping and an inverse addition check; the seven memo points now correspond to these requested steps.

content_corrections.issue: The memo awarded both an equivalent fraction and the same simplified fraction as separate points.
content_corrections.resolution: Asked learners to show simplification and verify the result; revised points now separate the starting ratio, common divisor, numerator/denominator operations, simplest form and check.

content_corrections.issue: The five-question scenario assessed sand/water separation and ice melting while its CAPS maps cited unrelated metals and flour/water processing content.
content_corrections.resolution: Rebuilt the assessment around the Grade 5 CAPS concrete-processing example, before/after properties and explicit fair-test/recording skills; rebound each question to relevant official pages.

content_corrections.issue: The wording treated production input and expense as alternatives, although the fruit is both an input and an expense.
content_corrections.resolution: Reworded the item to permit both roles and updated its six one-mark memo points to distinguish the input, expense, table fee, sales purpose and overlapping categories.

content_corrections.issue: Eleven marks were assigned to one final-velocity calculation.
content_corrections.resolution: Expanded the item to require both final velocity and signed displacement from the velocity-time graph area, then mapped it to the relevant official CAPS motion/graph pages.

content_corrections.issue: A no-reversal path made distance equal displacement, and the follow-up assessed average velocity without average speed.
content_corrections.resolution: Specified a return segment so distance is 36 m while displacement is +12 m, then asked for both average speed (6 m·s⁻¹) and average velocity (+2 m·s⁻¹ east) over the same six seconds.
